SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-01-2017 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BODINGHAUER, HANS IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT HILTON WORLDWIDE HOLDINGS INC. DEFENDANT HILTON WORLDWIDE HOLDINGS, INC. SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF NOTHING. PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM AGAINST DOUGLAS MAIRENA IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS AN IMPROPER PARTY. PLAINTIFF FAILED TO SERVE NAMED DEFENDANT HILTON HOTELS AND RESORTS, WHICH DID NOT APPEAR AND WHICH PLAINTIFF CLAIMS IS RESPONSIBLE FOR HIS LOSS. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
